targets.rawSql: SELECT state FROM bot_state WHERE bot_id='structure'

SELECT CASE WHEN paper_clock_started_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(0, FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - paper_clock_started_at)) / 86400)::int) END AS paper_clock_day FROM bot_state WHERE bot_id='structure'
SELECT ROUND(promotion_score::numeric, 3) FROM bot_state WHERE bot_id='structure'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='structure' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='open'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='structure' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM halts WHERE bot_id='structure' AND halted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, signal_type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM signals WHERE bot_id='structure' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT exit_at AS time, SUM(pnl_usd) OVER (ORDER BY exit_at) AS pnl_cum FROM trades WHERE bot_id='structure' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND exit_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY exit_at
SELECT created_at AS time, calibration_ratio AS value FROM calibration_records WHERE bot_id='structure' ORDER BY created_at

WITH slip AS (SELECT (sim_metadata->>'slippage_bps')::float AS bps FROM trades WHERE bot_id='structure' AND mode IN ('paper','shadow') AND sim_metadata->>'slippage_bps' IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') SELECT CASE WHEN bps < 5 THEN '0-5' WHEN bps < 10 THEN '5-10' WHEN bps < 25 THEN '10-25' WHEN bps < 50 THEN '25-50' WHEN bps < 100 THEN '50-100' ELSE '100+' END AS bucket, MIN(bps) AS sort_key, COUNT(*) AS count FROM slip GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sort_key
SELECT id, asset, direction, entry_price, size_usd, leverage, entry_at FROM trades WHERE bot_id='structure' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='open' ORDER BY entry_at DESC
SELECT halted_at, halt_type, severity, reason, resumed_at FROM halts WHERE bot_id='structure' AND halted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' ORDER BY halted_at DESC

panels.title: Signals by generator (last 7d)
panels.description: Healthy STRUCTURE shows multiple generators firing. If only funding_fade appears, the others are starved or broken.

targets.rawSql: SELECT signal_type, direction, COUNT(*) AS count FROM signals WHERE bot_id='structure' AND signal_type IN ('funding_fade','liquidation_cascade','whale_flip','hl_oi_divergence') AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Signal generator health (24h fire counts)
panels.description: All four generators should be firing during paper trading. Zero firings on a generator after 24h = investigate (data feed broken, thresholds too tight, or pool starved).

targets.rawSql: WITH expected AS (SELECT unnest(ARRAY['funding_fade','liquidation_cascade','whale_flip','hl_oi_divergence']) AS signal_type), counts AS (SELECT signal_type, COUNT(*) AS n_24h FROM signals WHERE bot_id='structure' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY 1) SELECT e.signal_type, COALESCE(c.n_24h, 0) AS n_24h, CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.n_24h, 0) > 0 THEN 'firing' ELSE 'silent' END AS status FROM expected e LEFT JOIN counts c USING (signal_type) ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Whales in pool
panels.description: Curated whale_list.json size. Target 30-50; below 10 = whale_flip detector starved.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (payload->>'whale_address')) AS active_whales FROM signals WHERE bot_id='structure' AND signal_type='whale_flip' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'

panels.title: OI divergence signals (last 7d)
panels.description: Each row = one fired signal. oi_delta_pct >= 20 + |price_delta_pct| >= 2 was the trigger.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at, asset, direction, payload->>'trigger' AS trigger, ROUND((payload->>'oi_delta_pct')::numeric, 2) AS oi_delta_pct, ROUND((payload->>'price_delta_pct')::numeric, 2) AS price_delta_pct FROM signals WHERE bot_id='structure' AND signal_type='hl_oi_divergence' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
